intent: Form field that opens kit Calendar to pick one date or a date range.
useWhen: A date in a form or filter
Need a typed-looking field whose overlay is Calendar
A period between two dates (mode range), like invoice due vs last month for a report
doNotUseWhen: The month grid is already on the page — use Calendar
A schedule of events — not DatePicker and not this kit Calendar

mode.note: single is one YYYY-MM-DD. range is { start, end? }. Not DateRangePicker.

value.note: controlled. string when single; { start, end? } when range. YYYY-MM-DD.

defaultValue.note: uncontrolled. string when single; { start, end? } when range.

onValueChange.note: (date: string) => void when single; (range: { start: string, end?: string }) => void when range

size.note: Trigger size; Calendar in the overlay is sm when size is sm, else md. No lg on the field.

placeholder.note: Defaults to Pick a date, or Pick dates when mode is range

name.note: Hidden input for forms. Range submits start/end, like 2026-08-10/2026-08-18

describedBy.note: Field wires hint and error ids onto the trigger

requirements: Trigger is a button with aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded, aria-controls
Overlay is role=dialog aria-modal labelled Choose date (or Choose dates in range) and contains kit Calendar
Range: first click sets start, second click sets end and closes. Escape discards an in-progress range
Tab stays in the overlay; Escape and pointer down outside close and return focus to the trigger
Calendar overlay anchors to the end of the trigger so it fits in drawers without horizontal scroll
Must have associated label via Field or a visible label pointing at id
error described by Field via describedBy

doNot: Do not invent a local calendar, Popover, DatePickerDialog, DateRangePicker, PeriodPicker, DualCalendar, or native input type=date
Do not use two DatePickers for start and end — use mode=range
Do not skip kit Calendar in the overlay
Do not add built-in label, hint, error text, help, or hideLabel — wrap with Field
Do not add time, Density, or a third field size
snippet:
<Field label="Start date" htmlFor="start-date"><DatePicker id="start-date" value={date} onValueChange={setDate} /></Field>
<Field label="Report period" htmlFor="period"><DatePicker id="period" mode="range" value={range} onValueChange={setRange} /></Field>
